title: By 4 months, most babies turn their head toward a voice
summary: The CDC 4-month language list says most babies turn their head towards the sound of a voice.
body: One language line on the CDC 4-month page is that the baby turns their head towards the sound of your voice. That is a listening response, separate from the cooing line on the same page and separate from making sounds back when someone talks. The page files it under what most babies do by 4 months. It does not say a baby who does not turn has a hearing loss. The mark belongs to the United States checklist.
